第三章前不见古人那古人就可怜可怜我吧（第1页）
大雪渐渐停歇，山间依旧阴冷潮湿。当冷风刷刷的吹过山间的松树。松叶如琴弦一般被吹的刷刷响。这世上好似开启了一场自然的音乐会。但过往的人们不会鉴赏，更不会驻足。这并不是他们不想而是不能。
存粮已经见底，陈默不得不冒险往山林更深处走。外围草药早已被采摘干净，再不走远些，他和小雪就要断粮。
他将小雪牢牢揣在怀中，握紧手里用来开路的木棍，深一脚浅一脚踏在积雪里。山林深处人迹罕至，不仅路难走，还常有野兽出没，危险重重。
行出数里，周遭树木愈发茂密，空气中弥漫着一股腐朽的土腥味。前方一片低洼处，散落着几座坍塌的旧坟，坟包被积雪半掩，石碑断裂倒伏，一看便是荒废了不知多少年的荒冢。
此地偏僻，寻常村民、修士都不会靠近。
陈默本想绕道而行，可目光扫过坟边的低矮灌木丛，发现里面长着几株品相不错的草药。为了活下去，他顾不上忌讳，走上前去采摘。
积雪覆盖了地面，脚下泥土松软湿滑。他弯腰采摘时，脚下一滑，整个人踉跄着摔在一座坍塌的老坟旁。
坟土本就松动，经他一撞，半边坟丘轰然垮塌，露出下方一个残破的木棺。棺木早已腐朽发黑，多处碎裂，里面的尸骨也早已散落，只剩下些许残骨。
陈默心中一惊，连忙后退几步。可贫困已久，让他下意识打量棺内，想着会不会有前人遗留的物件，哪怕是些许铜器，也能换些粮食。
他壮着胆子，用木棍拨开破碎的棺木残片。棺内空空荡荡，唯有棺角处，压着一卷用油布层层包裹的东西。
油布历经岁月，早已发硬发暗，却依旧没有完全破损。陈默伸手将其取了出来，入手干燥，分量很轻。
他走到稍远的空地上，一层层拆开老旧的油布。里面是一卷泛黄的兽皮卷，边缘磨损严重，上面写着密密麻麻的古朴字迹，还有一些奇怪的图谱。
他自幼只识得几个粗浅文字，大半内容都看不明白，只能勉强认出开篇几个字。他只当这是古人留下的寻常手札、杂记，半点没往修行法门上面去想。
寒风掠过山林，吹得兽皮卷微微晃动。陈默捏着这卷来历不明的旧物，心绪复杂。
他只是个挣扎在温饱线上的凡人，这卷残破的旧卷，于他而言，算不上什么值钱物件。
四周荒坟死寂，风声呜咽。他低头看了看怀里安然的小雪，又看向手中泛黄的兽皮卷。
前路依旧茫茫，他将兽皮卷仔细收好，揣进贴身的衣襟里，不敢有半分外露。随后匆匆采完草药，趁着天色未黑，快步朝着山下走去。

山风凛冽，他的身影渐渐消失在密林之中。眼下的他，依旧是那个食不果腹、饱受欺凌的凡人，只把荒坟所得当作一件无关紧要的旧物。殊不知这也悄悄的改变了他的命运。

Chapter 3 If I haven’t seen the ancients before, then the ancients will pity me (page 1)
The heavy snow gradually stopped, but the mountains were still cold and damp. When the cold wind blows through the pine trees in the mountains. The pine leaves were blown like strings. It’s like a natural concert has begun in this world. But people passing by will not appreciate it, let alone stop. It’s not that they don’t want to but that they can’t.
The food reserves had bottomed out, and Chen Mo had to risk going deeper into the mountains and forests. The surrounding herbs have been picked long ago. If they don't go further, he and Xiaoxue will run out of food.
He held Xiaoxue firmly in his arms, held the wooden stick in his hand to open the way, and stepped deeply into the snow. The deep mountains and forests are inaccessible. Not only are the roads difficult to walk, but wild animals often appear, making them full of dangers.
After walking for several miles, the surrounding trees became denser and thicker, and the air was filled with the smell of decaying earth. There are several collapsed old graves scattered in a low-lying area in front of them. The graves are half covered by snow, and the stone tablets are broken and collapsed. At first glance, they look like barren tombs that have been abandoned for countless years.
This place is remote, and ordinary villagers and monks will not approach it.
Chen Mo wanted to take a detour, but he glanced at the low bushes beside the grave and found several good-looking herbs growing in them. In order to survive, he ignored taboos and stepped forward to pick.
Snow covered the ground, and the soil was soft and slippery underfoot. When he bent down to pick, his feet slipped and he stumbled and fell next to an old tomb that collapsed.
The soil in the tomb was already loose, but when he hit it, half of the tomb collapsed, revealing a broken wooden coffin underneath. The coffin has long been rotten, blackened, and broken in many places. The bones inside have long been scattered, leaving only a few bones.
Chen Mo was shocked and quickly took a few steps back. But he had been poor for a long time, so he subconsciously looked inside the coffin, wondering if there were any objects left by his predecessors, even some copperware, which could be exchanged for some food.
He took courage and used a wooden stick to push apart the broken coffin fragments. The coffin was empty except for a roll wrapped in oilcloth at the corner.
The oilcloth has hardened and darkened over the years, but it is still not completely damaged. Chen Mo reached out and took it out. It was dry and light in weight.
He walked to an open space a little further away and unpacked the old oilcloth layer by layer. Inside is a roll of yellowed animal skin, with badly worn edges, densely packed ancient handwriting, and some strange maps.
He had only been able to read a few rudimentary words since he was a child, and could not understand most of the content. He could only barely recognize the first few words. He just thought these were ordinary notes and miscellaneous notes left by ancient people, and did not think about the practice method at all.
The cold wind swept through the mountain forest, causing the animal skin rolls to sway slightly. Chen Mo held this old item of unknown origin with mixed feelings.
He was just a mortal struggling to make ends meet. This old, torn scroll was not a valuable item to him.
The surrounding graves were deathly silent, and the wind howled. He looked down at Xiaoxue, who was safe in his arms, and then at the yellowed animal skin roll in his hand.
The road ahead was still unclear, so he carefully put the animal skin roll away and put it into his close-fitting clothes, not daring to expose any of it. Then he hurriedly gathered the herbs and walked quickly down the mountain while it was still dark.
The mountain wind was strong, and his figure gradually disappeared into the dense forest. At the moment, he is still the hungry, bullied mortal who only regards the proceeds from the barren grave as an insignificant old thing. Little did he know that this also quietly changed his destiny.
